_comment_: fleet-ops#1165: 0509 protected verifier/deploy files. An intake or scout SKIP for any issue whose files touch these — they require a repo-admin verifier-attest and Nish is on vacation (2026-08-28..2026-09-08). Without the skip, workers keep opening ci/workflow PRs that sit red on the attest gate until Nish returns. The protected_files list is sourced from 0509's .github/scripts/required-verifier-integrity.sh (the source of truth for what the gate protects); this is the fleet-ops-side copy that the intake tick and scout reference so they never need a network fetch into 0509.
_comment_park: Issues touching these files on protected repos are parked (skipped from intake/scout) until after the vacation window. After 2026-09-08 this config can be removed or the park_until lifted, restoring default behaviour.
